title: The invoice that does not add up
skill_text:
---
name: invoice-check
description: Total an invoice and apply a discount.
---
1. List each line item with its price.
2. Add the prices to get the subtotal.
3. If the subtotal is over 100, take 10% off; otherwise take nothing off.
4. Output JSON with exactly these keys: subtotal, discount, total.
input: Items: desk lamp 34.50, notebook 8.25, monitor stand 61.00, cable 5.25.
why_it_breaks: Arithmetic across steps: a small model drifts on the running total.
